info.description: Admin customer PO/order CRUD, conversion and negative cases are included and use admin_token without module permissions. Sales app /api/mobile/v1 uses api_token and shows only creator-owned leads/quotations in the selected plant. Admin app /api/mobile uses admin_token for plant-scoped lead and submitted quotation review. Import the shared environment, set both accounts and plant_id. Run Login, Create lead/quotation, Submit quotation, Admin login/review, then Refresh quotation. Run alternatives and delete actions individually.

Live delivery uses Reverb while connected; FCM/APNs is not implemented. On tap map subject_type + subject_id to the app screen and load the record through its API; record permissions still apply. CrmLead -> GET /leads/{id}; Quotation -> GET /quotations/{id}; SalesOrder -> GET /orders/{id}; CustomerPO -> GET /customer-pos/{id}. There is no public send-test endpoint: create/update a disposable business record with the normal API, with PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED, Reverb and queue worker running. Filter live events by plant_id and refresh history on reconnect. Requires PUSH_NOTIFICATION.RECEIVE to subscribe. Only connect when enabled, configured and can_receive are true. Saves notification_channel; obtain socket_id from a real WebSocket connection before authorizing. Notification behavior: this request does not directly trigger a business push notification.
